channel.title: Aniimo Guide News
channel.description: Official Aniimo launch updates with source-aware summaries.

item.title: Aniimo Is Officially Live on iOS and Android
item.description: Aniimo mobile is now live worldwide with same-server cross-platform progression and official launch rewards.

item.title: Aniimo Version 1.1 Adds Irisalis, Chaos Mode and New Events
item.description: The September 23 update adds the Irisalis legendary journey, Egg Heist Chaos Mode, events, quality-of-life changes and bug fixes.

item.title: Official Steam Launch Notice Covers Queues, Rewards and Test Data
item.description: Aniimo is live on Steam; the official launch notice flags possible login queues and explains launch-reward and prior-test data boundaries.

item.title: Official Beta Reward and Account-Linking Instructions Published
item.description: Aniimo explains how eligible test players should use their test email, and when support is required to protect an existing character.

item.title: Official PC and Console FAQ Covers Download, Progress and Support
item.description: Pawprint Studio documents PC/PS5/Xbox download routes, same-server cross-platform progress and common install guidance.

item.title: Official Intel 13th/14th-Gen Stability Notice Published
item.description: Pawprint Studio advises affected desktop Intel users with crashes or out-of-VRAM errors to review BIOS and microcode guidance.

item.title: Aniimo Dev Letter Confirms Launch-Version Changes
item.description: Xbox cloud gaming, Egg Heist Chaos Mode, revised catching, training, Home and control improvements are confirmed for launch.

item.title: Aniimo Global Launch Dates Confirmed
item.description: PC and consoles launch September 16, followed by mobile September 23.

item.title: PS5 Pre-Order Packs and Prices Verified
item.description: The US PS5 store lists Advanced and Collector's reward packs while the base game remains free.

item.title: Steam Lists 13 Text Languages and Four Full-Audio Languages
item.description: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean currently have full-audio support on Steam.
